rounds.notes: Parts first, two passes. Head: a six-sided origami wedge, two flat face planes meeting at the nose ridge (lit on the key side, as in the pick), brow and cheek planes, and a slanted underside from the pointed chin to the nape, so the jaw line reads. Neck: folded in to a V (two tendon planes to the sternum notch) in front of the trap planes. Torso: eight-sided rings with real dihedral breaks: a sharp centre line from the sternum to the navel, flat pec plates with a hard lower edge where they fold under, a narrow ab column whose side planes turn back hard, and a shallower waist. Waistband: a separate band standing clear of the belly with a lip folded over its top edge; briefs cut high at the hip with a V front panel. Hands: a palm, four separate three-segment fingers (each its own length and curl, hooking in toward the thigh), a pointed thumb flap and a folded wrist cuff. Limbs twist their planes onto the diagonal like the pick's folds; kneecaps are their own folded plates; feet are folded paper shoes (pentagon sections with a ridge along the top, closing to a point) under an ankle cuff. Deltoids and the arm and leg outlines are round 1's, traced from the pick.
